subject: Re: Evidence request - VM cadence, SLAs, and remediation attestations
messages:
From: Asha Nair <security@finledger.com>
To: mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence request - VM cadence, SLAs, and remediation attestations

Mina,

Thanks for taking this on. As part of our SOC 2 re-assessment and SIG review, FinLedger needs a consolidated packet showing:
- your vulnerability scan cadence (internal + third-party scans) for the past 12 months
- SLA commitments for CVE remediation by severity (P1/P2/P3) and any escalation paths
- evidence of closure for public CVEs referenced in our questionnaire (we flagged 7 items)
- a signed attestation we can retain in our audit folder

Can you provide a single index file (CSV) linking to artifacts and a short attestation statement by EOD Friday (9/17)? If you have a standard remediation SLA table, please include that too.

Appreciate a point of contact for any follow-ups — cc'd is fine.

Regards,
Asha Nair
Security Manager, FinLedger
security@finledger.com
[external][attachment: finledger-questionnaire.xlsx (XLSX, 45 KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Evidence request - VM cadence, SLAs, and remediation attestations

Hi Asha — thanks for the clear list. We'll assemble a single deliverable and the signed attestation. High-level plan below and I'll forward the artifacts once we've packaged them.

Summary of what we'll provide:
- VM cadence: weekly authenticated internal scans + bi-weekly external/credentialed 3rd-party scans; quarterly full dependency SCA sweep.
- SLA table: P1 (critical) = remediate or mitigation deployed within 14 business days; P2 (high) = 45 business days; P3 (medium/low) = 90 business days or scheduled roadmap item. We will include escalation path details.
- Evidence: indexed CSV mapping CVE IDs -> scan report extract -> remediation PR/Jira -> verification snapshot.
- Signed attestation: brief one-paragraph attestation describing processes, scan cadence, and SLA baseline signed by our Head of Security.

Timeline: final packet and attestation by Fri 2027-09-17 17:00 PT. If you need anything sooner (e.g., the 7 flagged CVEs first), tell me and I'll prioritize.

Attachments: [Attachment: vm-evidence-index.csv (CSV, 12 KB)] — this is the initial index skeleton.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: Evidence request - Evidence packaging and attestation language

Mina — reviewing the index: a few notes before we send externally.

1) SLA language: can we swap from "business days" to "calendar days" for clarity in audit documents? FinLedger's legal prefers calendar days. Proposed: P1 = 14 calendar days; P2 = 45 calendar days; P3 = 90 calendar days.
2) For the 7 flagged CVEs, include a short remediation summary line (one sentence) and link to the verification artifact. Don't paste the whole logs into the CSV.
3) Add a single-page summary PDF (patch-rollout-timeline.pdf) that shows the end-to-end timeline per CVE (discovery -> triage -> fix -> verify). That helps auditors.
4) Rishi, can you confirm we can sign attestation with the Head of Security's delegated signature this week?

I'll prep the summary PDF; Mina, when you forward externally, include the Drive folder link and JIRA ticket FIN-12345 for traceability.

-Kimberly
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: patch-rollout-timeline.pdf (PDF, 88 KB)]
